messages:
mina: Heads-up — onboarding voyager-v1 (float32 -> int8) shows a weird detok issue for CJK corner quotes when the input contains an RTL chunk (Arabic). Thought you all should see a repro.

mina: Quick repro case: a Chinese sentence that quotes a phrase after an Arabic fragment ends up with the corner quotes flipped.

lee: can you paste the exact prompt + model + tokenizer? also is this on staging only?

mina: Model: voyager-v1 (quantized to int8 with qk-1). Tokenizer: shared sentencepiece (voyager-sp). Staging and local int8 run both show it. float32 is fine.

mina: Example (trimmed):
```
Prompt: Translate into Chinese: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: صباح الخير"
Expected: 他说：『早上好』
Actual: 他说：』早上好『
```

yusuf: whoa. is that a decode bug or detok mapping? ids look in-order?

mina: I checked token ids around the quote tokens — order looks correct. Suspect detok mapping or a bidi-aware detok path that flips glyph mapping under RTL context.

sasha: try running with --no-bidi-normalize and also run float32 path to confirm quant-only regression?

mina: float32 => correct. int8 => broken. --no-bidi-normalize didn't change result. So seems specific to int8 runtime kernel path.

ada-bot: runtime-log: kernel=detok_fuse_v2 used for int8 runs, detok_map=table_v3, run_id=1768889999-01

lee: can you share a minimal script that prints token ids + decode so we can inspect whether decode() or detok table does it?

mina: pasted small repro script below:
```
from redwood.tokenizer import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer('voyager-sp')
s = "他说：صباح الخير ‘早上好’"
ids = tok.encode(s)
print(ids)
print(tok.decode(ids))
```
Output on int8 run:
```
[101, 5022, 30, 4163, 999, ...]
Decoded: 他说：』早上好『
```

toby: If ids are fine then mapping table might have swapped codepoints under bidi mode. Could also be a subtle endianness/pack bug in GPU->CPU memcpy used by fused kernel.

yusuf: I'll bisect commits touching detok_fuse_v2 and table_v3. If someone can produce the smallest ascii/rtl combo that flips, I'll use that for automated bisect.

mina: smallest repro lines attached: (1) "早上好" (2) "صباح الخير 早上好" — only (2) flips quotes. gist with full repro: https://gist.github.com/mina/voyager-detok-repro 

lee: ran a 200-sample zh-translation smoke (mixed locale) against voyager-int8: chrF dropped 0.78 -> 0.72, BLEU mild drop, non-CJK samples stable. Pushed artifact to /runs/1768889999/voyager-int8-eval.

sasha: tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml triage. sounds like kernel/regression. :eyes:  @yusuf and @lee assigned.

infra-bot: deploy: staging/voyager-int8 on ppool-4 started by yusuf at 1768890120

yusuf: update: bisect narrowed it to a change in detok_fuse_v2 commit 4f2c9a5 -> introduced a conditional that toggles mapping order when "has_rtl" flag is set. Small repro reproduces locally. Filing PR to revert mapping order and add unit tests.

mina: lovely. can we add a regression test to token-diff-suite that covers mixed-orient quotes and an explicit bidi sentinel? also add a smoke that compares token->char roundtrip for both float32 and int8.

sasha: agreed, add both. after patch lands we'll run canary then staged rollout. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

lee: any immediate mitigations? fallback to float32 or alternate detok table?

yusuf: I'm attaching a hotfix: force detok_fuse_v2 to use table_v2 when "has_rtl" present until we roll the proper fix. will push to staging canary.

mina: testing hotfix now on ppool-4 canary. will report back in ~15m.

infra-bot: canary deploy complete on ppool-4 at 1768890450

mina: canary check: sample reproducer now returns correct quotes for canary build. re-running the 200-sample smoke now.

lee: thanks — please add a regression ticket and link PRs.

sasha: created ENG-ML ticket #1428 with summary "Voyager-int8 detok quote flip on RTL context" and linked PRyusuf/1768. Keep updates in this thread.
